name: Computer Science
subtitle: 🚧 Study plan coming soon · 129 CH
bio: Provides students with up-to-date knowledge, skills and abilities in computer science and information technology, through comprehensive and continuously reviewed programs, research projects, and new tracks. 129 credit hours: University Req. 19-20, Faculty Req. 32, Program Req. 72 (49 compulsory + 23 elective across General/Serious-Gaming/Health-Informatics concentration tracks), Free Electives 5-6. 🚧 The department published course lists and prerequisites but not per-course credit hours or semester placement, so the interactive study plan isn't available yet — coming soon once that detail is confirmed.
